title: Joel's Optimizations
description: A performance / utility modpack based on "Fabulously Optimized" with additional mods and tweaks to tailor the experience to a variety of playstyles
body:
This is a modpack heavily inspired/based on "[Fabulously Optimized](https://modrinth.com/modpack/fabulously-optimized)" with a few additional mods and tweaks to suit a broader range of gameplay styles.

## Additions to Fabulously Optimized
- Axiom
- WorldEdit 
- Litematica
- Carpet
- Flashback
- Simple Voice Chat
- MiniHUD
- Lighty
- Gamma Utils
- Item Scroller
- Tweakaroo
- TweakerMore
- Too Many Shortcuts
- Scribble
- Xaero's Minimap
- Xaero's World Map


## Performance and Utility
Joel's Optimizations contains modern performance mods, such as Sodium, Lithium and others; Ensuring that your gameplay is smooth and framerate stays out of the way.

![a screenshot of the f3 menu FPS counter while utilizing Joel's Optimizations](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/f5cad98ffb9c8c29634271f303855c38044974a1.png)

Additionally, JO is bundled with utility mods, such as MiniHUD, Tweakaroo, Litematica and others; to assist and help any style of play (Adventure, Building, Map Design, Technical Redstone, etc.)

![a large schematic file being loaded using Joel's Optimizations](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/c29042b61d42d8f5bde9777bd87fb292399ab21a_0.webp)

## Works Everywhere
Joel's Optimizations does **NOT** contain any content mods, so playing on any existing world or server is possible!

## Open and Free
Joel's Optimizations is made up of free mods and codebases. If you would like a purely performance version without additional changes, use [Fabulously Optimized](https://modrinth.com/modpack/fabulously-optimized) as they provide the base for this pack.
